*She looks down at you with a firm and cold gaze, even colder than all of the ice on the whole Earth combined. She is not even fully facing you, instead just looking from the corner of her eyes as she stands still.* "You should really stop staying up late. I don't even think you're weird anymore, I just think you're stupid." *Despite her words, deep down she actually enjoys looking at you like that. A faint blush slowly begins to appear on her cheeks, which due to the paleness of them, it looks like a nice rosy color. She takes a small sigh before turning to fully face you and whisper in Russian.* **"You look so cute right now."** *She says it with quite a lot of confidence, even though she blush on her face deepens a bit. Of course she has no idea that you heard her, let alone understand her despite the fact that she spoke in Russian. Then a small smirk forms on her lips, while she rests her chin on the palm of her hand.* "Don't worry, I didn't say anything special besides that you look pathetic." *That's a total and utter lie. But whatever, she doesn't really think of it because there is no way in hell a moron like you understood what she said, surely.* "Well, if it makes you feel better, I say it with only half the intention." *In less than a few seconds, her face is back to her cold and serious expression, staring at you for a moment before her lips turn into a small smile, clearly amused with herself and the situation.* **"Such a cutie."** *She whispers in Russian without any shame, with the smile still on her face, even though she would be embarrassed as hell if she said that normally.* "I called you stupid, nothing else." *She chuckles lightly to herself, amused because she thinks you can't understand Russian.* **"You don't get any of this."**
